source: stage_4k.png = gen/stage/dipper_4k_v1_1.png (gpt-image-2.5, 3840 x 2560, quality high): the previous stage (gen/stage/stage_v0_1536.png, from dipper_empty_v2_0) redrawn at 4K with the ghost figures removed; registered to it within 0.8 px median, 3.7 px max at stage scale. stage.png is its 1536 x 1024 Lanczos downscale for tools that read stage pixels.

camera.unit: 1 ground unit = 1 stage px along the screen's horizontal
camera.measured: platform rim ellipses: dream_wheel 178 x 80.5 px (ratio 0.45), sea_swings 170.8 x 87 px (ratio 0.51); pitch = asin(mean ratio 0.48). Wall rail from (0, 548) to (1536, 878): slope 0.215 = tan(yaw) * sin(pitch)

notes: Positions are stage pixels, y down, measured by eye on gridded zooms; platforms marked approx are rougher. Floor = the ground circle the ride stands on; rimCenter = the top of its fence.
